readerCopy.body: A workaround you did not plan may give you access to an option the old system kept making unnecessarily difficult. When Uranus sextiles the North Node, a new tool, unusual introduction, revised schedule, different route, or exception can remove one stubborn source of friction and make another approach practical enough to try. You do not need to reinvent everything because one better method appeared. Test it where the old process was blocking you and keep it if it gives you more choice without creating another problem you now have to work around.
